items.title: SK海力士調整中國布局？30億美元重慶廠傳尋找投資人
items.title_en: SK Hynix Adjusting Its China Footprint? $3 Billion Chongqing Plant Said to Be Seeking Investors
paras: 南韓記憶體大廠 SK 海力士 (SKHY-US) 據傳正評估中國重慶廠的多項處置方案，包括引進投資人以加速業務成長。知情人士透露，若公司最終決定出售部分股權，這座廠區的估值可能達到約 30 億美元。
《彭博》周五 (7 日) 報導，SK 海力士目前正與潛在顧問接洽，準備對重慶業務展開評估。可能的買家包括中國基金及產業業者，公司則可能保留該資產的少數股權。不過，相關討論仍處於初步階段，不一定會促成任何交易。SK 海力士代表拒絕置評。
SK 海力士是輝達 (Nvidia) 高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 的主要供應商之一，進入中國市場已有逾 20 年。公司當年與中國江蘇省無錫市簽署協議，設立首座大型海外晶圓製造廠；重慶廠則是其大規模半導體封裝與測試基地，協助公司擴大全球 NAND 快閃記憶體後段製程產能。
在評估引資重慶廠的同時，SK 海力士也持續擴大南韓本土投資。公司周五宣布，計劃投入 54 兆韓元 (約 380 億美元) 擴充晶片製造設施，包括在龍仁興建新的 DRAM 生產設施，並於清州打造 NAND 晶圓廠。
SK 海力士表示，這項投資是為了因應人工智慧 (AI) 時代日益成長的記憶體需求。相關布局顯示，公司可能一面重新調整中國後段製程資產的持股結構，一面將大筆資本支出集中於南韓先進記憶體產能，但目前尚無跡象顯示重慶廠評估案已作出最終決定。
paras_en: South Korean memory giant SK Hynix (SKHY-US) is reportedly evaluating several options for its Chongqing plant in China, including bringing in investors to accelerate business growth. Sources say that if the company ultimately decides to sell a portion of its equity, the site could be valued at roughly $3 billion.

Bloomberg reported on Friday (the 7th) that SK Hynix is in talks with potential advisors as it prepares to assess the Chongqing operation. Possible buyers could include Chinese funds and industry players, while the company may retain a minority stake in the asset. However, the discussions are still in early stages and may not lead to any transaction. An SK Hynix spokesperson declined to comment.

SK Hynix is one of Nvidia’s main suppliers of high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and has been in the Chinese market for more than 20 years. The company signed an agreement that year with Wuxi in Jiangsu Province to set up its first large overseas wafer fab; the Chongqing plant serves as a major semiconductor packaging and testing hub, helping the company expand its global NAND flash back‑end capacity.

While evaluating capital infusion for the Chongqing plant, SK Hynix continues to expand its domestic investments in South Korea. On Friday the company announced plans to invest 54 trillion won (about $38 billion) to expand chip‑making facilities, including a new DRAM production line in Yongin and a NAND wafer fab in Cheongju.

SK Hynix said the investment is aimed at meeting the growing memory demand of the artificial‑intelligence (AI) era. The overall strategy suggests the company may be reshaping its ownership structure in China’s back‑end assets while concentrating large capital expenditures on advanced memory capacity in South Korea, though there is no sign yet that a final decision on the Chongqing plant has been made.

items.title: Fed還升得下去嗎？華爾街看完非農都說先等等 升息恐扼殺製造業復甦
paras: 美國 7 月非農就業意外減少 2.3 萬人，6 月增幅也由 5.7 萬人大幅下修至 2 萬人，使市場開始質疑聯準會 (Fed) 是否仍有條件在 9 月升息。不過，華爾街分析師普遍認為，一個月的疲弱數據還不足以證明就業市場已陷入衰退，但足以讓 Fed 重新權衡升息對就業的傷害，9 月按兵不動的可能性明顯升高。
美國 7 月失業率由 4.2% 降至 4.1%，主要受到勞動參與率持續下滑影響。Fed 上周以 9 票對 3 票決定將利率維持在 3.50% 至 3.75%，三名異議官員則主張升息 1 碼 (25 個基點)。就業報告公布後，期貨市場預估 Fed 9 月升息機率由 55% 降至 40%。

升息恐先傷製造業「治療可能比疾病更糟」

Annex Wealth Management 首席經濟學家 Brian Jacobsen 指出，Fed 接下來必須格外謹慎，因為升息通常最先、也最嚴重地衝擊製造業。如今製造業就業才剛浮現復甦跡象，若為了壓抑通膨而收緊政策，可能反而扼殺這波萌芽中的改善。
Jacobsen 認為，目前服務業通膨已逐步降溫，商品價格上漲主要由關稅與能源成本推動，並非貨幣政策過度寬鬆所致。在這種情況下，升息未必能有效處理通膨根源，付出的經濟代價反而可能超過成效，尤其 7 月就業疲弱可能帶有季節性，而非結構性惡化。
他預估，面對結構性通膨問題，Fed 主席華許可能更傾向優先縮減資產負債表，而不是透過升息壓低需求。如果 9 月仍有太多決策官員要求升息，華許甚至可能投下反對票。

單月數據不是趨勢 但足以讓 Fed 暫停升息

Ameriprise Financial 首席市場策略師 Anthony Saglimbene 表示，即使 7 月非農就業出現負值，美國勞動市場整體仍算健康，因此不宜過度解讀單月數據，「一個數字並不構成趨勢」。不過，這份報告確實為 Fed 在 9 月暫停升息提供更多空間。
Saglimbene 指出，Fed 近期政策討論明顯偏重控制通膨，但疲弱的就業數據可能重新調整討論方向，讓決策官員更加重視充分就業這一側的法定任務。若未來升息可能進一步壓抑企業聘僱，Fed 就有理由先觀察政策影響。他預期，Fed 最終不會在 9 月升息。
高盛資產管理多元固定收益投資主管 Lindsay Rosner 也傾向 Fed 按兵不動。她表示，歷史不會完全重演，但有時會呈現相似節奏；這已是連續第三年出現 7 月就業成長在盛夏失去動能的情況，顯示季節性因素可能放大數據疲弱程度。
Rosner 強調，接下來的通膨數據仍將是 Fed 是否升息的最終裁決者，但就業成長放緩已為 9 月維持利率不變提供支持。換言之，華爾街並未因非農轉負而立即判定經濟衰退，卻普遍認為，在通膨成因未必能靠升息解決、就業風險逐漸浮現之際，Fed 沒有必要急於進一步緊縮。

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉非農意外轉負緩解Fed升息疑慮 主要指數開高
paras: 美股周五 (7 日) 開盤走高，標普 500 指數與那斯達克指數雙雙上揚。美國 7 月非農就業意外減少 2.3 萬人，顯示勞動市場明顯降溫，儘管數據本身令人失望，投資人卻看見其「好的一面」，認為聯準會 (Fed) 短期內無須急於升息，9 月按兵不動的可能性升高，帶動股市與債市同步走揚。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲 0.02%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近 220 點或近 0.9%，標普 500 指數漲 0.3%，費城半導體指數漲近 2.2%。台積電 ADR 漲近 0.6%。
美國 7 月非農就業人數意外減少，且前幾個月數據遭大幅下修，顯示勞動市場明顯降溫，緩解投資人對聯準會 (Fed) 短期內可能再度升息的擔憂，帶動美股期指與美國公債同步走高，美元則轉弱。
美股盤前，標普 500 指數期貨上漲 0.4%；債市買氣升溫，10 年期美債殖利率下跌 6 個基點至 4.62%。美元也隨殖利率走低，反映市場開始重新評估 Fed 未來的利率政策路徑。
美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 周五公布，7 月非農就業人口意外減少 2.3 萬人，顯示企業雇主在當月縮減人力。此前數月就業人數也遭明顯下修，暗示年初一度展現韌性的美國勞動市場，可能正面臨更大壓力。
不過，美國 7 月失業率由前月下降至 4.1%，表面上顯示就業市場仍具韌性，但背後原因之一是勞動參與率持續下滑。這代表部分勞工退出求職行列，因此失業率下降未必等同就業情勢改善。
地緣政治方面，美國總統川普表示，伊朗與阿曼針對荷姆茲海峽的談判「正在取得進展」，但最終協議仍未完成，相關細節據傳仍在德黑蘭內部討論。
荷姆茲海峽管理協議已成為市場評估能源供應能否進一步恢復的重要因素。近期即使區域衝突時有發生，能源運輸仍未完全中斷，但流量低於美伊戰爭爆發前。若這條全球關鍵能源航道重新開放，不僅有助提高原油運輸量，也可能為美伊重啟更廣泛談判、推動結束衝突鋪路。

items.title: 日元又突然急升！非農爆冷還是美日再度干預？
items.title_en: Yen Suddenly Surges Again! Is It Due to Cold Non-Farm Data or US-Japan Intervention?
paras: 美國 7 月非農就業數據意外轉為負成長，重挫聯準會 (Fed) 升息預期，帶動美元全面走弱，日元兌美元周五 (7 日) 盤中突然大漲。由於美日當局才在數日前聯手進場支撐日元，交易員也高度警戒官方可能再度干預匯市。
美元兌日元一度重挫 1.1% 至 156.68 日元，隨後跌幅略為收斂，最新報 157.16 日元，已明顯遠離 7 月觸及的 163.99 日元、40 年來高點。
目前尚不清楚日本當局是否再次進場干預。不過，分析師指出，美國就業數據遠遜預期，加上美債殖利率大幅下跌，已足以促使投資人拋售美元，因此這波日元升勢可能主要由基本面因素推動。
三菱日聯金融集團 (MUFG) 資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman 表示，非農就業數據低於預期的幅度非常大，觀察美國殖利率曲線短端的劇烈反應，美元下跌並不令人意外。由於非農就業出現負值相當罕見，這次數據對 Fed 升息預期造成明顯打擊，市場理應出現強烈反應，美元也可能面臨廣泛賣壓。
美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 周五公布，7 月非農就業人口意外減少 2.3 萬人，6 月增幅則由原先公布的 5.7 萬人下修至 2 萬人。《路透》調查的經濟學家原先預估，7 月就業人口將增加 8 萬人，預測區間介於增加 1 萬至 14 萬人。
就業數據公布後不久，日本財務大臣表示，東京與華府一直保持「密切溝通」，必要時將毫不猶豫地干預匯市，進一步加深交易員戒心。
日本與美國上周五才罕見採取協調行動，共同買進日元，以阻止日元持續貶值。隨著疲弱非農數據為日元提供基本面支撐，加上美日官員持續釋出干預警告，市場正密切關注日元是否延續反彈，以及官方是否再次出手。
paras_en: The US 7-month non-farm employment data unexpectedly turned negative, severely undercutting the Federal Reserve's (Fed) interest rate hike expectations, leading to a sharp decline in the US dollar, and a sudden surge in the yen against the US dollar on Friday (7).

The US dollar against the yen plummeted by 1.1% to 156.68 yen, before narrowing its decline, and was last reported at 157.16 yen, clearly far removed from the 163.99 yen, a 40-year high touched in July.

It remains unclear whether Japanese authorities have intervened again in the foreign exchange market. However, analysts point out that the US employment data fell far short of expectations, coupled with a sharp decline in US Treasury yields, which is enough to prompt investors to sell the US dollar, and thus the yen's surge may be driven primarily by fundamental factors.

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) senior foreign exchange analyst Lee Hardman stated that the non-farm employment data fell short of expectations by a very large margin, and observed a sharp reaction in the US short-term interest rate curve, making the decline in the US dollar not unexpected.

The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reported on Friday that the non-farm employment population unexpectedly decreased by 23,000 in July, and the June increase was revised downward to 20,000 from the originally reported 57,000. Reuters' survey of economists had previously estimated that the employment population would increase by 800,000 in July, with a prediction range of 100,000 to 1.4 million.

Shortly after the release of employment data, Japan's Finance Minister stated that Tokyo and Washington have maintained 'close communication', and would intervene in the foreign exchange market without hesitation if necessary, further deepening the caution among traders.

Japan and the US took a rare coordinated action last Friday, jointly buying the yen to block its continued depreciation. With weak non-farm data providing fundamental support for the yen, and US and Japanese officials continuing to issue warnings of intervention, the market is closely watching whether the yen will continue its rebound, and whether officials will intervene again.

items.title: ETF資金流入點火 比特幣重回6.5萬美元 但市場情緒仍為「極度恐懼」
items.title_en: ETF Inflows Ignite Bitcoin's Rally Back to $65,000, But Market Sentiment Remains 'Extreme Fear'
paras: 比特幣在經歷了低迷的 7 月後，於 8 月初展現反彈力道，受美國比特幣現貨 ETF 連續 4 天資金流入的推動，比特幣價格周五 (7 日) 已重新收復 65,000 美元大關。
交易數據顯示，自 2026 年 8 月 3 日以來，現貨 ETF 累計注入約 6.26 億美元，其中以貝萊德 (BlackRock) 的 IBIT 領頭，伴隨巨鯨戶的累積以及槓桿拋售壓力的減少，助力價格突破關鍵阻力位。
然而，雖然 8 月出現資金流入，但相較於第二季的巨大流出顯得微不足道。SEC 文件顯示，貝萊德的比特幣與以太幣 ETF 在第二季資本活動淨減少 35 億美元，與去年同期的 139 億美元增長形成強烈對比。這意味著近期的流入僅是在修補第二季大規模贖回造成的缺口，而非建立在強勢的基礎上。
市場情緒也並未隨價格回升而顯著好轉，「加密貨幣恐懼與貪婪指數」仍停留在 25 的「極度恐懼」區間。此外，交易量呈現價升量縮的背離現象，24 小時現貨交易量下降約 16%，顯示這是一次低參與度、低信念的波動，容易迅速消退。
早前，最大企業持有者 Strategy 也在 7 月底至 8 月初間出售了 1,638 枚比特幣 (約 1.04 億美元) 以履行其義務。
宏觀經濟與監管環境持續籠罩市場。比特幣與標普 500 指數的相關性高達 83.6%，顯示其走勢深受整體風險情緒主導。
在監管方面，《CLARITY Act》法案因未能在參議院休會前表決，被推遲至 9 月，增加了政策不確定性。
paras_en: Bitcoin has shown a rebounding force in early August after a dismal July, driven by the continuous inflows of US Bitcoin spot ETF over four consecutive days, with the price of Bitcoin recovering the $65,000 threshold on Friday (7th).

Trading data shows that since August 3, 2026, the spot ETF has accumulated approximately $626 million, led by BlackRock's IBIT, accompanied by the accumulation of large whales and the decrease in leverage selling pressure, helping the price break through the critical resistance level.

However, despite the inflows in August, they are negligible compared to the massive outflows in the second quarter. SEC documents show that BlackRock's Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF had a net capital outflow of $3.5 billion in the second quarter, a stark contrast to the $13.9 billion growth in the same period last year, indicating that recent inflows are only filling the gap caused by the massive redemption in the second quarter rather than building on a strong foundation.

Market sentiment has not improved significantly with the price rebound, with the 'Cryptocurrency Fear and Greed Index' still stuck at 25, in the 'Extreme Fear' range. Additionally, trading volume has shown a decoupling phenomenon, with a 16% decrease in 24-hour spot trading volume, indicating a low-participation, low-belief fluctuation that can easily dissipate.

items.title: 〈財報〉北美消費者不買了？Under Armour下修全年財測 盤前股價跌近5%
items.title_en: Under Armour Downgrades Full-Year Outlook Amid Weak Demand
paras: 運動服飾品牌 Under Armour(UAA-US) 周五 (7 日) 美股盤前公布 2027 會計年度第一季 (截至 6 月 30 日) 財報，儘管北美與亞太市場需求疲弱，營收持續下滑，公司仍轉虧為盈，調整後獲利也優於預期。不過，在消費環境充滿挑戰之際，公司下修全年營收展望，股價盤前下跌近 5%。
截稿前，Under Armour(UAA-US) 盤前股價下跌 4.84%，每股暫報 6.09 美元。
Under Armour 第一季營收年減 3% 至 11 億美元，略低於 LSEG 統計的分析師預估 11.1 億美元，但大致符合 FactSet 預期。其中，批發業務營收下滑 1.6% 至 6.385 億美元；最大市場北美營收銳減 9% 至 6.098 億美元，抵銷國際市場營收成長 5% 的表現。
公司當季淨利為 54.5 萬美元，相較去年同期淨損 261 萬美元成功轉盈，稀釋後每股盈餘為零。排除一次性項目後，每股盈餘為 0.05 美元，優於 FactSet 預估的 0.02 美元。毛利率大增 590 個基點至 54.1%，主要受到關稅退稅挹注。
Under Armour 預估，2027 會計年度營收將下滑中個位數百分比，較原先預估的「小幅下滑」更為悲觀，反映北美、亞太以及歐洲、中東等主要市場需求轉弱。執行長 Kevin Plank 表示，公司正面對充滿挑戰的消費需求環境。
不過，公司維持全年調整後營業利益 1.4 億至 1.6 億美元的預測，並預估調整後每股盈餘為 0.08 至 0.12 美元，分析師預期為 0.11 美元。相關財測納入約 7,000 萬美元關稅退稅挹注，以及中東戰事造成的約 3,500 萬美元不利影響。
Kevin Plank 自 2024 年回鍋擔任執行長以來，持續推動品牌轉型，包括將產品種類削減約 25%、減少折扣，並聚焦訓練、跑步及團體運動等價格較高的產品。公司也推出新款訓練鞋、棒球鞋與運動服飾，希望吸引 Z 世代消費者。
截至目前，Under Armour 已支出 2.66 億美元重整與轉型費用，預計年底前完成計畫。然而，Morningstar 分析師 David Swartz 指出，目前仍缺乏足夠證據顯示轉型策略已帶來顯著成效。關稅衝擊以及近期與 NBA 球星 Stephen Curry 結束合作，也為品牌復甦增添壓力。
paras_en: Under Armour (UAA-US) reported a first-quarter earnings beat despite weak demand in North America and Asia-Pacific, but downgraded its full-year revenue outlook, sending the stock down nearly 5% premarket.
Under Armour's (UAA-US) stock fell 4.84% premarket to $6.09 per share.
The company's first-quarter revenue declined 3% to $1.1 billion, slightly below the $1.11 billion estimate from LSEG and in line with FactSet's expectations.
Under Armour's net income for the quarter was $545,000, compared to a net loss of $2.61 million in the same period last year, with diluted earnings per share of zero.
Excluding one-time items, earnings per share were $0.05, beating FactSet's estimate of $0.02.
The company's gross margin expanded 590 basis points to 54.1%, mainly due to tax benefits.

Under Armour expects revenue to decline in the mid-single digits for the full year, more pessimistic than its previous forecast of 'slight decline', reflecting weaker demand in North America, Asia-Pacific, and Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

CEO Kevin Plank said the company is facing a challenging consumer demand environment, but is committed to its transformation efforts, including reducing product lines by 25%, cutting discounts, and focusing on higher-priced products such as training, running, and team sports.

items.title: 蘋果調高多款裝置以舊換新回收價格 新增多款安卓機型
items.title_en: Apple Raises Trade-In Values for Multiple Devices, Adds Android Options
paras: 蘋果 (AAPL-US) 調整多款 iPhone、iPad、Mac 和蘋果手錶以舊換新回收價格，並新增多款安卓手機回收，可能為日益感受到價格壓力的消費者帶來一定安慰。
蘋果對舊裝置回收價上漲幅度最高接近 30%，但也有一些裝置仍維持原價，總體平均漲幅為 6.6%。
值得注意的是，蘋果給出的不同機型回收價是最高價格，依據裝置的保存狀況、顏色、版本不同，價格可能無法達到所列水準。
對於安卓設備的回收，蘋果新增 6 款智慧手機回收，包括三星 Galaxy S21 Ultra 5G、Google Pixel 9 Pro XL、Google Pixel 9 Pro、Google Pixel 9、一加 13 和一加 13R。
Consumer Intelligence Research 的數據顯示，近 50% iPhone 買家在購買新機時會以舊換新或出售舊機。因此，蘋果提高舊裝置回收價格是一個頗具吸引力的優惠，可以提高粉絲在漲價時期繼續更新手機的意願。
蘋果擴大對安卓設備的回收，則有望擴大蘋果手機或其他裝置的銷售群體。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) has adjusted the trade-in values for multiple iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch models, and added trade-in options for several Android phones, which may bring some relief to consumers feeling price pressure.
Apple's trade-in values for old devices have increased by as much as 30%, but some devices still maintain their original prices, with an average increase of 6.6%.

It's worth noting that Apple's trade-in prices for different models are the highest prices, and the actual price may not reach the listed level depending on the device's condition, color, and version.
For Android devices, Apple has added six new trade-in options, including the Samsung Galaxy S21 Ultra 5G, Google Pixel 9 Pro XL, Google Pixel 9 Pro, Google Pixel 9, OnePlus 13, and OnePlus 13R.

According to data from Consumer Intelligence Research, nearly 50% of iPhone buyers will trade in their old device or sell it when purchasing a new one. Therefore, Apple's increased trade-in values are a highly attractive offer that can encourage fans to continue updating their phones even in a period of price increases.
By expanding trade-in options for Android devices, Apple may be able to expand its sales group for Apple phones or other devices.

items.title: 川普將與礦企高層開會 確保關鍵礦產供應
items.title_en: Trump to Meet Mining Executives to Ensure Critical Mineral Supplies
paras: 美國總統川普將於 7 日（周五）在美國國務院召集全球部分大型礦業公司高層開會，以期採取行動，確保美國及盟友的關鍵礦產供應。
今天預計出席的業界巨頭包括全球礦業巨頭力拓集團、澳洲必和必拓、美國自由港 - 麥克莫蘭銅金公司、美國芒廷山口材料公司、美國稀土公司、美國能源燃料公司、加拿大金屬公司等。
消息人士說，川普政府計劃宣布多項交易與諒解備忘錄。
據《路透社》報導，美國現正急需關鍵礦產來補充對伊朗戰事期間耗損的武器庫存。在長達 5 個多月的伊朗戰爭中，美軍大量消耗精確導引飛彈與防空攔截彈。
美國國防官員和議員均警告，鑑於現有產能受限，補充部分庫存可能將耗時數年——儘管川普政府對「彈藥庫存嚴重短缺」的報導予以否認。
五角大廈官員及防務企業透露，稀土、鎢、鍺、鈧等礦產供應，對製造精確導引飛彈、戰機、裝甲車輛、紅外傳感器及其他先進武器系統必不可少。
paras_en: US President Trump will convene a meeting at the State Department on Friday with top executives from major mining companies to take action to ensure the supply of critical minerals for the US and its allies.
Industry leaders expected to attend include BHP, Rio Tinto, Freeport-McMoRan, Mountain Pass Materials, US Rare Earths, Energy Fuels, and Teck Resources.
Sources say the Trump administration plans to announce several deals and memoranda of understanding.

According to a Reuters report, the US is currently in urgent need of critical minerals to replenish its stockpiles depleted during the Iran conflict. During the five-month Iran war, the military consumed large quantities of precision-guided missiles and anti-aircraft interceptors.

US defense officials and lawmakers have warned that replenishing some stockpiles could take years due to limited production capacity, despite the Trump administration's denial of reports of 'severe ammunition shortages'.

Pentagon officials and defense contractors have revealed that rare earths, rhenium, gallium, and neodymium are essential minerals for manufacturing precision-guided missiles, fighter jets, armored vehicles, infrared sensors, and other advanced weapon systems.

items.title: SK海力士調整中國布局？30億美元重慶廠傳尋找投資人
items.title_en: SK Hynix Adjusting Its China Footprint? $3 Billion Chongqing Plant Said to Be Seeking Investors
paras: 南韓記憶體大廠 SK 海力士 (SKHY-US) 據傳正評估中國重慶廠的多項處置方案，包括引進投資人以加速業務成長。知情人士透露，若公司最終決定出售部分股權，這座廠區的估值可能達到約 30 億美元。
《彭博》周五 (7 日) 報導，SK 海力士目前正與潛在顧問接洽，準備對重慶業務展開評估。可能的買家包括中國基金及產業業者，公司則可能保留該資產的少數股權。不過，相關討論仍處於初步階段，不一定會促成任何交易。SK 海力士代表拒絕置評。
SK 海力士是輝達 (Nvidia) 高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 的主要供應商之一，進入中國市場已有逾 20 年。公司當年與中國江蘇省無錫市簽署協議，設立首座大型海外晶圓製造廠；重慶廠則是其大規模半導體封裝與測試基地，協助公司擴大全球 NAND 快閃記憶體後段製程產能。
在評估引資重慶廠的同時，SK 海力士也持續擴大南韓本土投資。公司周五宣布，計劃投入 54 兆韓元 (約 380 億美元) 擴充晶片製造設施，包括在龍仁興建新的 DRAM 生產設施，並於清州打造 NAND 晶圓廠。
SK 海力士表示，這項投資是為了因應人工智慧 (AI) 時代日益成長的記憶體需求。相關布局顯示，公司可能一面重新調整中國後段製程資產的持股結構，一面將大筆資本支出集中於南韓先進記憶體產能，但目前尚無跡象顯示重慶廠評估案已作出最終決定。
paras_en: South Korean memory giant SK Hynix (SKHY-US) is reportedly evaluating several options for its Chongqing plant in China, including bringing in investors to accelerate business growth. Sources say that if the company ultimately decides to sell a portion of its equity, the site could be valued at roughly $3 billion.

Bloomberg reported on Friday (the 7th) that SK Hynix is in talks with potential advisors as it prepares to assess the Chongqing operation. Possible buyers could include Chinese funds and industry players, while the company may retain a minority stake in the asset. However, the discussions are still in early stages and may not lead to any transaction. An SK Hynix spokesperson declined to comment.

SK Hynix is one of Nvidia’s main suppliers of high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and has been in the Chinese market for more than 20 years. The company signed an agreement that year with Wuxi in Jiangsu Province to set up its first large overseas wafer fab; the Chongqing plant serves as a major semiconductor packaging and testing hub, helping the company expand its global NAND flash back‑end capacity.

While evaluating capital infusion for the Chongqing plant, SK Hynix continues to expand its domestic investments in South Korea. On Friday the company announced plans to invest 54 trillion won (about $38 billion) to expand chip‑making facilities, including a new DRAM production line in Yongin and a NAND wafer fab in Cheongju.

SK Hynix said the investment is aimed at meeting the growing memory demand of the artificial‑intelligence (AI) era. The overall strategy suggests the company may be reshaping its ownership structure in China’s back‑end assets while concentrating large capital expenditures on advanced memory capacity in South Korea, though there is no sign yet that a final decision on the Chongqing plant has been made.

items.title: Fed還升得下去嗎？華爾街看完非農都說先等等 升息恐扼殺製造業復甦
paras: 美國 7 月非農就業意外減少 2.3 萬人，6 月增幅也由 5.7 萬人大幅下修至 2 萬人，使市場開始質疑聯準會 (Fed) 是否仍有條件在 9 月升息。不過，華爾街分析師普遍認為，一個月的疲弱數據還不足以證明就業市場已陷入衰退，但足以讓 Fed 重新權衡升息對就業的傷害，9 月按兵不動的可能性明顯升高。
美國 7 月失業率由 4.2% 降至 4.1%，主要受到勞動參與率持續下滑影響。Fed 上周以 9 票對 3 票決定將利率維持在 3.50% 至 3.75%，三名異議官員則主張升息 1 碼 (25 個基點)。就業報告公布後，期貨市場預估 Fed 9 月升息機率由 55% 降至 40%。

升息恐先傷製造業「治療可能比疾病更糟」

Annex Wealth Management 首席經濟學家 Brian Jacobsen 指出，Fed 接下來必須格外謹慎，因為升息通常最先、也最嚴重地衝擊製造業。如今製造業就業才剛浮現復甦跡象，若為了壓抑通膨而收緊政策，可能反而扼殺這波萌芽中的改善。
Jacobsen 認為，目前服務業通膨已逐步降溫，商品價格上漲主要由關稅與能源成本推動，並非貨幣政策過度寬鬆所致。在這種情況下，升息未必能有效處理通膨根源，付出的經濟代價反而可能超過成效，尤其 7 月就業疲弱可能帶有季節性，而非結構性惡化。
他預估，面對結構性通膨問題，Fed 主席華許可能更傾向優先縮減資產負債表，而不是透過升息壓低需求。如果 9 月仍有太多決策官員要求升息，華許甚至可能投下反對票。

單月數據不是趨勢 但足以讓 Fed 暫停升息

Ameriprise Financial 首席市場策略師 Anthony Saglimbene 表示，即使 7 月非農就業出現負值，美國勞動市場整體仍算健康，因此不宜過度解讀單月數據，「一個數字並不構成趨勢」。不過，這份報告確實為 Fed 在 9 月暫停升息提供更多空間。
Saglimbene 指出，Fed 近期政策討論明顯偏重控制通膨，但疲弱的就業數據可能重新調整討論方向，讓決策官員更加重視充分就業這一側的法定任務。若未來升息可能進一步壓抑企業聘僱，Fed 就有理由先觀察政策影響。他預期，Fed 最終不會在 9 月升息。
高盛資產管理多元固定收益投資主管 Lindsay Rosner 也傾向 Fed 按兵不動。她表示，歷史不會完全重演，但有時會呈現相似節奏；這已是連續第三年出現 7 月就業成長在盛夏失去動能的情況，顯示季節性因素可能放大數據疲弱程度。
Rosner 強調，接下來的通膨數據仍將是 Fed 是否升息的最終裁決者，但就業成長放緩已為 9 月維持利率不變提供支持。換言之，華爾街並未因非農轉負而立即判定經濟衰退，卻普遍認為，在通膨成因未必能靠升息解決、就業風險逐漸浮現之際，Fed 沒有必要急於進一步緊縮。

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉非農意外轉負緩解Fed升息疑慮 主要指數開高
paras: 美股周五 (7 日) 開盤走高，標普 500 指數與那斯達克指數雙雙上揚。美國 7 月非農就業意外減少 2.3 萬人，顯示勞動市場明顯降溫，儘管數據本身令人失望，投資人卻看見其「好的一面」，認為聯準會 (Fed) 短期內無須急於升息，9 月按兵不動的可能性升高，帶動股市與債市同步走揚。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲 0.02%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近 220 點或近 0.9%，標普 500 指數漲 0.3%，費城半導體指數漲近 2.2%。台積電 ADR 漲近 0.6%。
美國 7 月非農就業人數意外減少，且前幾個月數據遭大幅下修，顯示勞動市場明顯降溫，緩解投資人對聯準會 (Fed) 短期內可能再度升息的擔憂，帶動美股期指與美國公債同步走高，美元則轉弱。
美股盤前，標普 500 指數期貨上漲 0.4%；債市買氣升溫，10 年期美債殖利率下跌 6 個基點至 4.62%。美元也隨殖利率走低，反映市場開始重新評估 Fed 未來的利率政策路徑。
美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 周五公布，7 月非農就業人口意外減少 2.3 萬人，顯示企業雇主在當月縮減人力。此前數月就業人數也遭明顯下修，暗示年初一度展現韌性的美國勞動市場，可能正面臨更大壓力。
不過，美國 7 月失業率由前月下降至 4.1%，表面上顯示就業市場仍具韌性，但背後原因之一是勞動參與率持續下滑。這代表部分勞工退出求職行列，因此失業率下降未必等同就業情勢改善。
地緣政治方面，美國總統川普表示，伊朗與阿曼針對荷姆茲海峽的談判「正在取得進展」，但最終協議仍未完成，相關細節據傳仍在德黑蘭內部討論。
荷姆茲海峽管理協議已成為市場評估能源供應能否進一步恢復的重要因素。近期即使區域衝突時有發生，能源運輸仍未完全中斷，但流量低於美伊戰爭爆發前。若這條全球關鍵能源航道重新開放，不僅有助提高原油運輸量，也可能為美伊重啟更廣泛談判、推動結束衝突鋪路。

items.title_en: Yen Suddenly Surges Again! Is It Due to Cold Non-Farm Data or US-Japan Intervention?
paras: 美國 7 月非農就業數據意外轉為負成長，重挫聯準會 (Fed) 升息預期，帶動美元全面走弱，日元兌美元周五 (7 日) 盤中突然大漲。由於美日當局才在數日前聯手進場支撐日元，交易員也高度警戒官方可能再度干預匯市。
美元兌日元一度重挫 1.1% 至 156.68 日元，隨後跌幅略為收斂，最新報 157.16 日元，已明顯遠離 7 月觸及的 163.99 日元、40 年來高點。
目前尚不清楚日本當局是否再次進場干預。不過，分析師指出，美國就業數據遠遜預期，加上美債殖利率大幅下跌，已足以促使投資人拋售美元，因此這波日元升勢可能主要由基本面因素推動。
三菱日聯金融集團 (MUFG) 資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman 表示，非農就業數據低於預期的幅度非常大，觀察美國殖利率曲線短端的劇烈反應，美元下跌並不令人意外。由於非農就業出現負值相當罕見，這次數據對 Fed 升息預期造成明顯打擊，市場理應出現強烈反應，美元也可能面臨廣泛賣壓。
美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 周五公布，7 月非農就業人口意外減少 2.3 萬人，6 月增幅則由原先公布的 5.7 萬人下修至 2 萬人。《路透》調查的經濟學家原先預估，7 月就業人口將增加 8 萬人，預測區間介於增加 1 萬至 14 萬人。
就業數據公布後不久，日本財務大臣表示，東京與華府一直保持「密切溝通」，必要時將毫不猶豫地干預匯市，進一步加深交易員戒心。
日本與美國上周五才罕見採取協調行動，共同買進日元，以阻止日元持續貶值。隨著疲弱非農數據為日元提供基本面支撐，加上美日官員持續釋出干預警告，市場正密切關注日元是否延續反彈，以及官方是否再次出手。
paras_en: The US 7-month non-farm employment data unexpectedly turned negative, severely undercutting the Federal Reserve's (Fed) interest rate hike expectations, leading to a sharp decline in the US dollar, and a sudden surge in the yen against the US dollar on Friday (7).

The US dollar against the yen plummeted by 1.1% to 156.68 yen, before narrowing its decline, and was last reported at 157.16 yen, clearly far removed from the 163.99 yen, a 40-year high touched in July.

It remains unclear whether Japanese authorities have intervened again in the foreign exchange market. However, analysts point out that the US employment data fell far short of expectations, coupled with a sharp decline in US Treasury yields, which is enough to prompt investors to sell the US dollar, and thus the yen's surge may be driven primarily by fundamental factors.

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) senior foreign exchange analyst Lee Hardman stated that the non-farm employment data fell short of expectations by a very large margin, and observed a sharp reaction in the US short-term interest rate curve, making the decline in the US dollar not unexpected.

The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reported on Friday that the non-farm employment population unexpectedly decreased by 23,000 in July, and the June increase was revised downward to 20,000 from the originally reported 57,000. Reuters' survey of economists had previously estimated that the employment population would increase by 800,000 in July, with a prediction range of 100,000 to 1.4 million.

Shortly after the release of employment data, Japan's Finance Minister stated that Tokyo and Washington have maintained 'close communication', and would intervene in the foreign exchange market without hesitation if necessary, further deepening the caution among traders.

Japan and the US took a rare coordinated action last Friday, jointly buying the yen to block its continued depreciation. With weak non-farm data providing fundamental support for the yen, and US and Japanese officials continuing to issue warnings of intervention, the market is closely watching whether the yen will continue its rebound, and whether officials will intervene again.

items.title: 〈財報〉北美消費者不買了？Under Armour下修全年財測 盤前股價跌近5%
items.title_en: Under Armour Downgrades Full-Year Outlook Amid Weak Demand
paras: 運動服飾品牌 Under Armour(UAA-US) 周五 (7 日) 美股盤前公布 2027 會計年度第一季 (截至 6 月 30 日) 財報，儘管北美與亞太市場需求疲弱，營收持續下滑，公司仍轉虧為盈，調整後獲利也優於預期。不過，在消費環境充滿挑戰之際，公司下修全年營收展望，股價盤前下跌近 5%。
截稿前，Under Armour(UAA-US) 盤前股價下跌 4.84%，每股暫報 6.09 美元。
Under Armour 第一季營收年減 3% 至 11 億美元，略低於 LSEG 統計的分析師預估 11.1 億美元，但大致符合 FactSet 預期。其中，批發業務營收下滑 1.6% 至 6.385 億美元；最大市場北美營收銳減 9% 至 6.098 億美元，抵銷國際市場營收成長 5% 的表現。
公司當季淨利為 54.5 萬美元，相較去年同期淨損 261 萬美元成功轉盈，稀釋後每股盈餘為零。排除一次性項目後，每股盈餘為 0.05 美元，優於 FactSet 預估的 0.02 美元。毛利率大增 590 個基點至 54.1%，主要受到關稅退稅挹注。
Under Armour 預估，2027 會計年度營收將下滑中個位數百分比，較原先預估的「小幅下滑」更為悲觀，反映北美、亞太以及歐洲、中東等主要市場需求轉弱。執行長 Kevin Plank 表示，公司正面對充滿挑戰的消費需求環境。
不過，公司維持全年調整後營業利益 1.4 億至 1.6 億美元的預測，並預估調整後每股盈餘為 0.08 至 0.12 美元，分析師預期為 0.11 美元。相關財測納入約 7,000 萬美元關稅退稅挹注，以及中東戰事造成的約 3,500 萬美元不利影響。
Kevin Plank 自 2024 年回鍋擔任執行長以來，持續推動品牌轉型，包括將產品種類削減約 25%、減少折扣，並聚焦訓練、跑步及團體運動等價格較高的產品。公司也推出新款訓練鞋、棒球鞋與運動服飾，希望吸引 Z 世代消費者。
截至目前，Under Armour 已支出 2.66 億美元重整與轉型費用，預計年底前完成計畫。然而，Morningstar 分析師 David Swartz 指出，目前仍缺乏足夠證據顯示轉型策略已帶來顯著成效。關稅衝擊以及近期與 NBA 球星 Stephen Curry 結束合作，也為品牌復甦增添壓力。
paras_en: Under Armour (UAA-US) reported a first-quarter earnings beat despite weak demand in North America and Asia-Pacific, but downgraded its full-year revenue outlook, sending the stock down nearly 5% premarket.
Under Armour's (UAA-US) stock fell 4.84% premarket to $6.09 per share.
The company's first-quarter revenue declined 3% to $1.1 billion, slightly below the $1.11 billion estimate from LSEG and in line with FactSet's expectations.
Under Armour's net income for the quarter was $545,000, compared to a net loss of $2.61 million in the same period last year, with diluted earnings per share of zero.
Excluding one-time items, earnings per share were $0.05, beating FactSet's estimate of $0.02.
The company's gross margin expanded 590 basis points to 54.1%, mainly due to tax benefits.

Under Armour expects revenue to decline in the mid-single digits for the full year, more pessimistic than its previous forecast of 'slight decline', reflecting weaker demand in North America, Asia-Pacific, and Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

CEO Kevin Plank said the company is facing a challenging consumer demand environment, but is committed to its transformation efforts, including reducing product lines by 25%, cutting discounts, and focusing on higher-priced products such as training, running, and team sports.

items.title: 蘋果調高多款裝置以舊換新回收價格 新增多款安卓機型
items.title_en: Apple Raises Trade-In Values for Multiple Devices, Adds Android Options
paras: 蘋果 (AAPL-US) 調整多款 iPhone、iPad、Mac 和蘋果手錶以舊換新回收價格，並新增多款安卓手機回收，可能為日益感受到價格壓力的消費者帶來一定安慰。
蘋果對舊裝置回收價上漲幅度最高接近 30%，但也有一些裝置仍維持原價，總體平均漲幅為 6.6%。
值得注意的是，蘋果給出的不同機型回收價是最高價格，依據裝置的保存狀況、顏色、版本不同，價格可能無法達到所列水準。
對於安卓設備的回收，蘋果新增 6 款智慧手機回收，包括三星 Galaxy S21 Ultra 5G、Google Pixel 9 Pro XL、Google Pixel 9 Pro、Google Pixel 9、一加 13 和一加 13R。
Consumer Intelligence Research 的數據顯示，近 50% iPhone 買家在購買新機時會以舊換新或出售舊機。因此，蘋果提高舊裝置回收價格是一個頗具吸引力的優惠，可以提高粉絲在漲價時期繼續更新手機的意願。
蘋果擴大對安卓設備的回收，則有望擴大蘋果手機或其他裝置的銷售群體。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) has adjusted the trade-in values for multiple iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch models, and added trade-in options for several Android phones, which may bring some relief to consumers feeling price pressure.
Apple's trade-in values for old devices have increased by as much as 30%, but some devices still maintain their original prices, with an average increase of 6.6%.

It's worth noting that Apple's trade-in prices for different models are the highest prices, and the actual price may not reach the listed level depending on the device's condition, color, and version.
For Android devices, Apple has added six new trade-in options, including the Samsung Galaxy S21 Ultra 5G, Google Pixel 9 Pro XL, Google Pixel 9 Pro, Google Pixel 9, OnePlus 13, and OnePlus 13R.

According to data from Consumer Intelligence Research, nearly 50% of iPhone buyers will trade in their old device or sell it when purchasing a new one. Therefore, Apple's increased trade-in values are a highly attractive offer that can encourage fans to continue updating their phones even in a period of price increases.
By expanding trade-in options for Android devices, Apple may be able to expand its sales group for Apple phones or other devices.

items.title: 非農大爆冷！美國7月就業意外減少2.3萬人 聯準會9月升息機率驟降至4成
paras: 美國 7 月非農就業意外減少 2.3 萬人，不僅遠遜市場原先預期的增加 8.3 萬人，5 月與 6 月數據也合計遭大幅下修 10.3 萬人，顯示年初一度展現韌性的勞動市場正迅速降溫。就業與薪資成長雙雙放緩，促使交易員大幅降低聯準會 (Fed)9 月升息押注，美股期指走高，美債殖利率則應聲下挫。

7 月非農就業報告：


非農新增就業報 - 2.3 萬人，預期 8.5 萬人，修正後前值 2.0 萬人
失業率報 4.1%，預期 4.2%，前值 4.2%
 平均每周工時報 34.3 小時，預期 34.3 小時，前值 34.3 小時
平均每小時薪資年增率報 3.2%，預期 3.5%，修正後前值 3.4%
 平均每小時薪資月增率報 0.1%，預期 0.3%，前值 0.3%
 勞動參與率報 61.4%，前值 61.5%


就業意外轉負 失業率下降卻藏隱憂

美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 周五公布，7 月非農就業人口經季節調整後減少 2.3 萬人，為 2 月減少 15.6 萬人以來最差表現；6 月新增就業人數由 5.7 萬人大幅下修至 2 萬人，5 月也由 12.9 萬人下修至 6.3 萬人，兩個月合計較原先估計少 10.3 萬人。過去 12 個月平均每月新增就業人數因此降至僅 3.4 萬人。
就業減少主要來自政府部門、休閒與餐旅業及零售業。地方政府職位減少近 6 萬個，幾乎全部集中於教育業，可能與教師在暑假期間暫時退出薪資名冊有關；聯邦政府就業人數也持續下降。零售業減少 1.9 萬人，金融活動業則減少 1.4 萬人，降至四年最低，凸顯白領職位可能正面臨人工智慧應用帶來的壓力。
休閒與餐旅業就業降至近一年低點，餐廳及酒吧持續裁員，顯示 7 月 19 日落幕的世界盃足球賽未如部分經濟學家預期，為服務業就業帶來明顯提振。相較之下，民間部門連續第二個月增加 3 萬個職位，主要由醫療保健及社會救助帶動，其中醫療業增加 2.2 萬人，但仍低於過去 12 個月平均的 3.6 萬人。製造業與營建業就業則持續成長，資料中心建設可能是今年營建人力需求的重要支柱。
7 月失業率由 4.2% 降至 4.1%，但不完全代表就業情勢改善。當月失業人口減少 17.8 萬人，就業人口也減少 8.7 萬人，勞動參與率進一步降至 61.4%；若排除疫情期間的異常低點，這是 1970 年代以來最低水準，反映更多人退出勞動市場。

薪資降溫壓低升息押注 市場期待 Fed 按兵不動

薪資數據同樣低迷。7 月平均時薪僅月增 0.1%，低於市場預期及前月的 0.3%；年增率則降至 3.2%，創逾五年最慢增速，也不及市場預估的 3.5%。平均時薪當月僅增加 2 美分，顯示勞動供需轉弱正壓抑薪資漲幅。
這份報告凸顯 Fed 面臨的兩難：一方面，伊朗戰爭推升生活成本，通膨仍高於 2% 目標；另一方面，就業與薪資成長已明顯失速。Fed 上周以 9 票對 3 票決定維持利率不變，此前多位官員曾表態，若通膨未降溫，最快可能在 9 月升息。
數據公布後，LSEG 資料顯示，市場押注 Fed 於 9 月升息的機率由 57% 降至 43.9%，按兵不動的機率則由 43.2% 升至 60.4%。
芝商所 FedWatch 工具顯示，9 月升息機率也降至約 40%，10 月升息機率為 44.9%。市場對 Fed 轉趨鴿派的期待升溫，道瓊期貨一度上漲近 200 點，美債殖利率則大幅下挫。

items.title: 美股創高反而想跑？投資人獲利了結 557億美元湧向貨幣基金
items.title_en: US Stocks Hit Record High, Investors Flock to Cash Funds
paras: 美國股票型基金在截至 8 月 5 日當周轉為資金淨流出，投資人趁美股創高後獲利了結，並在周五公布 7 月非農就業報告前降低風險部位，以等待更多有關聯準會 (Fed) 利率走向的線索。
LSEG Lipper 數據顯示，美國股票型基金當周遭撤資 15.8 億美元，部分逆轉前一周 117.7 億美元的淨流入。標普 500 指數自上周低點 7,313.92 點反彈約 6.5%，並於周三觸及 7,793.68 點的歷史新高，主要受到亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)、開拓重工(CAT-US) 及 Palantir Technologies(PLTR-US)等企業財報亮眼提振。
市場正密切關注美國勞工部即將公布的 7 月就業報告。經濟學家預估，7 月非農就業人口將增加 8 萬人，高於 6 月的 5.7 萬人，失業率則料維持在 4.2%。相關數據將成為市場調整 Fed 利率預期的重要依據。
以基金類型來看，成長型股票基金當周淨流出 55 億美元，不僅扭轉前一周 31 億美元的淨流入，也成為整體股票基金失血的主因；價值型基金則獲得 19.9 億美元淨流入，反映部分資金轉向估值相對較低的標的。
產業型基金當周吸金規模降至三周低點 16.2 億美元，其中科技基金淨流入僅 3.88 億美元，創六周最低。相較之下，工業、醫療保健及非必需消費品基金分別吸引 8.75 億、8.66 億及 7.08 億美元資金。
避險需求同步升溫。美國債券基金當周淨流入 65.2 億美元，明顯高於前一周的 12.6 億美元；貨幣市場基金更吸引 556.9 億美元，在連續三周遭撤資後重獲投資人青睞，顯示就業數據揭曉前，資金正加速轉向防禦性資產。
paras_en: US equity funds saw net outflows for the week ended August 5, as investors locked in profits after the S&P 500 hit a record high and reduced risk positions ahead of the July nonfarm payrolls report.

According to LSEG Lipper data, US equity funds saw net withdrawals of $1.58 billion for the week, partially reversing the $1.18 billion net inflow seen in the previous week. The S&P 500 index rebounded about 6.5% from its low point of 7,313.92 on the previous week and touched a new historical high of 7,793.68 on Wednesday, mainly driven by strong earnings from Amazon (AMZN-US), Caterpillar (CAT-US), and Palantir Technologies (PLTR-US).

The market is closely watching the upcoming July employment report from the US Labor Department. Economists expect a nonfarm payroll increase of 800,000 in July, higher than the 570,000 in June, with the unemployment rate expected to remain at 4.2%. The data will be an important basis for adjusting expectations on the Federal Reserve's interest rate policy.

By fund type, growth equity funds saw net outflows of $5.5 billion for the week, not only reversing the $3.1 billion net inflow seen in the previous week but also becoming the main cause of overall stock fund outflows; value funds, on the other hand, saw a net inflow of $1.99 billion, reflecting a shift of funds to lower-valued targets.

Industry funds saw a net inflow of $162 million for the week, the lowest in three weeks, with technology funds seeing a net inflow of only $388 million, the lowest in six weeks. In contrast, industrial, healthcare, and non-essential consumer goods funds attracted $875 million, $866 million, and $708 million, respectively.

Risk aversion is on the rise. US bond funds saw a net inflow of $652 million for the week, significantly higher than the $126 million seen in the previous week; currency market funds attracted $5.569 billion, recovering from three consecutive weeks of net outflows, showing that investors are accelerating their shift to defensive assets ahead of the employment data release.

items.title: SK海力士調整中國布局？30億美元重慶廠傳尋找投資人
items.title_en: SK Hynix Adjusting Its China Footprint? $3 Billion Chongqing Plant Said to Be Seeking Investors
paras: 南韓記憶體大廠 SK 海力士 (SKHY-US) 據傳正評估中國重慶廠的多項處置方案，包括引進投資人以加速業務成長。知情人士透露，若公司最終決定出售部分股權，這座廠區的估值可能達到約 30 億美元。
《彭博》周五 (7 日) 報導，SK 海力士目前正與潛在顧問接洽，準備對重慶業務展開評估。可能的買家包括中國基金及產業業者，公司則可能保留該資產的少數股權。不過，相關討論仍處於初步階段，不一定會促成任何交易。SK 海力士代表拒絕置評。
SK 海力士是輝達 (Nvidia) 高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 的主要供應商之一，進入中國市場已有逾 20 年。公司當年與中國江蘇省無錫市簽署協議，設立首座大型海外晶圓製造廠；重慶廠則是其大規模半導體封裝與測試基地，協助公司擴大全球 NAND 快閃記憶體後段製程產能。
在評估引資重慶廠的同時，SK 海力士也持續擴大南韓本土投資。公司周五宣布，計劃投入 54 兆韓元 (約 380 億美元) 擴充晶片製造設施，包括在龍仁興建新的 DRAM 生產設施，並於清州打造 NAND 晶圓廠。
SK 海力士表示，這項投資是為了因應人工智慧 (AI) 時代日益成長的記憶體需求。相關布局顯示，公司可能一面重新調整中國後段製程資產的持股結構，一面將大筆資本支出集中於南韓先進記憶體產能，但目前尚無跡象顯示重慶廠評估案已作出最終決定。
paras_en: South Korean memory giant SK Hynix (SKHY-US) is reportedly evaluating several options for its Chongqing plant in China, including bringing in investors to accelerate business growth. Sources say that if the company ultimately decides to sell a portion of its equity, the site could be valued at roughly $3 billion.

Bloomberg reported on Friday (the 7th) that SK Hynix is in talks with potential advisors as it prepares to assess the Chongqing operation. Possible buyers could include Chinese funds and industry players, while the company may retain a minority stake in the asset. However, the discussions are still in early stages and may not lead to any transaction. An SK Hynix spokesperson declined to comment.

SK Hynix is one of Nvidia’s main suppliers of high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and has been in the Chinese market for more than 20 years. The company signed an agreement that year with Wuxi in Jiangsu Province to set up its first large overseas wafer fab; the Chongqing plant serves as a major semiconductor packaging and testing hub, helping the company expand its global NAND flash back‑end capacity.

While evaluating capital infusion for the Chongqing plant, SK Hynix continues to expand its domestic investments in South Korea. On Friday the company announced plans to invest 54 trillion won (about $38 billion) to expand chip‑making facilities, including a new DRAM production line in Yongin and a NAND wafer fab in Cheongju.

SK Hynix said the investment is aimed at meeting the growing memory demand of the artificial‑intelligence (AI) era. The overall strategy suggests the company may be reshaping its ownership structure in China’s back‑end assets while concentrating large capital expenditures on advanced memory capacity in South Korea, though there is no sign yet that a final decision on the Chongqing plant has been made.

items.title: 日元又突然急升！非農爆冷還是美日再度干預？
items.title_en: Yen Suddenly Surges Again! Is It Due to Cold Non-Farm Data or US-Japan Intervention?
paras: 美國 7 月非農就業數據意外轉為負成長，重挫聯準會 (Fed) 升息預期，帶動美元全面走弱，日元兌美元周五 (7 日) 盤中突然大漲。由於美日當局才在數日前聯手進場支撐日元，交易員也高度警戒官方可能再度干預匯市。
美元兌日元一度重挫 1.1% 至 156.68 日元，隨後跌幅略為收斂，最新報 157.16 日元，已明顯遠離 7 月觸及的 163.99 日元、40 年來高點。
目前尚不清楚日本當局是否再次進場干預。不過，分析師指出，美國就業數據遠遜預期，加上美債殖利率大幅下跌，已足以促使投資人拋售美元，因此這波日元升勢可能主要由基本面因素推動。
三菱日聯金融集團 (MUFG) 資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman 表示，非農就業數據低於預期的幅度非常大，觀察美國殖利率曲線短端的劇烈反應，美元下跌並不令人意外。由於非農就業出現負值相當罕見，這次數據對 Fed 升息預期造成明顯打擊，市場理應出現強烈反應，美元也可能面臨廣泛賣壓。
美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 周五公布，7 月非農就業人口意外減少 2.3 萬人，6 月增幅則由原先公布的 5.7 萬人下修至 2 萬人。《路透》調查的經濟學家原先預估，7 月就業人口將增加 8 萬人，預測區間介於增加 1 萬至 14 萬人。
就業數據公布後不久，日本財務大臣表示，東京與華府一直保持「密切溝通」，必要時將毫不猶豫地干預匯市，進一步加深交易員戒心。
日本與美國上周五才罕見採取協調行動，共同買進日元，以阻止日元持續貶值。隨著疲弱非農數據為日元提供基本面支撐，加上美日官員持續釋出干預警告，市場正密切關注日元是否延續反彈，以及官方是否再次出手。
paras_en: The US 7-month non-farm employment data unexpectedly turned negative, severely undercutting the Federal Reserve's (Fed) interest rate hike expectations, leading to a sharp decline in the US dollar, and a sudden surge in the yen against the US dollar on Friday (7).

The US dollar against the yen plummeted by 1.1% to 156.68 yen, before narrowing its decline, and was last reported at 157.16 yen, clearly far removed from the 163.99 yen, a 40-year high touched in July.

It remains unclear whether Japanese authorities have intervened again in the foreign exchange market. However, analysts point out that the US employment data fell far short of expectations, coupled with a sharp decline in US Treasury yields, which is enough to prompt investors to sell the US dollar, and thus the yen's surge may be driven primarily by fundamental factors.

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) senior foreign exchange analyst Lee Hardman stated that the non-farm employment data fell short of expectations by a very large margin, and observed a sharp reaction in the US short-term interest rate curve, making the decline in the US dollar not unexpected.

The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reported on Friday that the non-farm employment population unexpectedly decreased by 23,000 in July, and the June increase was revised downward to 20,000 from the originally reported 57,000. Reuters' survey of economists had previously estimated that the employment population would increase by 800,000 in July, with a prediction range of 100,000 to 1.4 million.

Shortly after the release of employment data, Japan's Finance Minister stated that Tokyo and Washington have maintained 'close communication', and would intervene in the foreign exchange market without hesitation if necessary, further deepening the caution among traders.

Japan and the US took a rare coordinated action last Friday, jointly buying the yen to block its continued depreciation. With weak non-farm data providing fundamental support for the yen, and US and Japanese officials continuing to issue warnings of intervention, the market is closely watching whether the yen will continue its rebound, and whether officials will intervene again.

items.title: 美日罕見聯手干預日元 高盛：彰顯美元儲備貨幣霸權不可替代
items.title_en: US and Japan Unite to Intervene in Yen, Goldman Sachs: Highlighting the Irreplaceable Dominance of Dollar as Reserve Currency
paras: 近期美國與日本展開罕見的聯合干預行動以支撐日元匯率，此舉引發外界對於美元作為儲備貨幣吸引力的討論。然而，高盛集團周四 (6 日) 發表報告指出，這次事件反而凸顯了美元在國際金融體系中無可取代的優勢，其深厚的市場深度與流動性，讓各國央行在市場劇烈波動時能迅速調用儲備。
日元先前因持續走弱而跌至 40 年來的低點，在美日協同干預前，日元兌美元匯率約為 164，干預後回升至約 158 左右。雖然部分市場人士擔心華盛頓對國債市場採取的積極態度可能令儲備管理者感到不安，但高盛認為這種擔憂是「過度跳躍的推論」。
高盛分析師表示，現任政府展現出比以往更強的干預意願，這並不代表美國國債市場出現新的脆弱性，反而體現了美元儲備在關鍵時刻的實用性。
高盛強調，美國資本市場的深度讓各國央行在平時能穩健累積美元，並在面臨壓力時順暢提取。此外，美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 提議調高聯準會「外國及國際貨幣當局 (FIMA) 回購工具」的上限，這將允許各國央行透過抵押國債暫時換取美元，而非直接拋售國債，進而減少因突然拋售國債而產生的市場動盪。
儘管高盛也提到美元長期面臨美國制度不確定性等潛在風險，但日本的經驗再次證明，競爭對手難以企及美元的優勢。
報告結論指出：「當到了需要干預的時刻，絕大多數央行仍然需要美元。」
paras_en: The US and Japan have recently embarked on a rare joint intervention to support the yen, sparking discussions about the attractiveness of the dollar as a reserve currency. However, Goldman Sachs Group released a report on Thursday (6th) stating that this event has instead highlighted the dollar's irreplaceable dominance in the international financial system, with its deep market depth and liquidity allowing central banks to quickly draw on their reserves during market turmoil.

The yen had previously weakened to a 40-year low, with the exchange rate against the dollar around 164 before the joint intervention, and rebounded to around 158 after the intervention. Although some market participants are concerned that Washington's aggressive stance on the debt market may cause unease among reserve managers, Goldman Sachs believes this concern is an 'overly hasty inference'.

Goldman Sachs analysts point out that the current government has shown a stronger willingness to intervene, which does not represent a new vulnerability in the US debt market, but rather the practicality of dollar reserves in critical times.

Goldman Sachs emphasizes that the depth of the US capital market allows central banks to accumulate dollars stably in normal times and smoothly draw on them when facing pressure. Additionally, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent proposed increasing the ceiling for the Federal Reserve's 'Foreign and International Monetary Authorities (FIMA) Repurchase Agreement Tool', which would allow central banks to temporarily exchange dollars for securities through collateral, rather than directly selling securities, thereby reducing market volatility caused by sudden sales of securities.

Although Goldman Sachs also mentions that the dollar faces potential risks such as US institutional uncertainty in the long term, Japan's experience once again proves that competitors cannot match the dollar's superiority.
The report concludes: 'When it's time to intervene, almost all central banks still need dollars.'

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯齊挫！一度摜破32.3關卡 中止連2升收32.288元
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar and Stock Index Suffer Losses as Tensions Rise
paras: 美伊緊張局勢再度升溫，台北股匯今 (7) 日同步走弱，新台幣兌美元匯率一度貶破 32.3 元關卡，不過，央行尾盤持續調節，終場貶幅收斂，收在 32.288 元、小貶 2.7 分，中止連二升，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 29.345 億美元。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為 32.24 元，最高來到 32.2 元，但隨著美元買盤湧現，匯價由升轉貶，最低下探 32.35 元，不過，出口商伺機進場，加上央行也進場調節，帶動貶幅收斂，終場收在 32.288 元，小貶 2.7 分。
觀察主要貨幣今天對美元表現，根據央行統計，美元指數上漲 0.20%，韓元強勢升值 0.66%，為本日最強亞幣，人民幣升值 0.07%，星幣微幅升值 0.02%，新台幣貶值 0.08%，日元重貶 0.34%，亞幣表現不同調。
台股今天一度上漲逾 430 點，但獲利了結賣壓出籠，指數翻黑下跌 170.79 點，終場收在 44225.91 點。外資賣超台股 407 億元。
受到市場對貨幣政策前景的不安情緒影響，美元周四表現支撐，投資人拋售美國公債，推升美債殖利率。市場把焦點轉向周五公布的 7 月非農就業報告，將成為聯準會利率走向的重要觀察指標。
paras_en: The Taiwan dollar and stock index suffered losses today as tensions between the US and Iran escalated, causing the dollar to rise against the Taiwan dollar. The Taiwan dollar fell to a low of 32.3 against the US dollar, but the central bank intervened to stabilize the market, resulting in a smaller loss of 2.7 points to close at 32.288.

The Taiwan dollar opened at 32.24 against the US dollar and rose to a high of 32.2, but then turned lower as dollar buying pressure increased. The lowest point was 32.35, but exporters and the central bank intervened to stabilize the market, resulting in a smaller loss of 2.7 points to close at 32.288.

The major currencies against the US dollar showed varying performances today, with the dollar index rising 0.20%, the Korean won rising 0.66% to become the strongest Asian currency, the Chinese yuan rising 0.07%, the Hong Kong dollar rising 0.02%, the Taiwan dollar falling 0.08%, the Japanese yen falling 0.34%, and the Asian currencies showing mixed performances.

The Taiwan stock index rose over 430 points at one point today, but then sold off due to profit-taking, resulting in a loss of 170.79 points to close at 44225.91. Foreign investors sold 407 billion Taiwan dollars worth of stocks.

The dollar rose today due to market concerns about monetary policy, with investors selling US bonds and pushing up the yield on US Treasury bonds. The market is now focusing on the release of the July non-farm employment report on Friday, which will be an important indicator of the Federal Reserve's interest rate decisions.

items.title: 日元已回吐近半干預漲幅 美日匯率保衛戰恐還有第二輪要打
items.title_en: Yen Gives Back Nearly Half of Intervention Gain, Fears of Second Round of Intervention Rise
paras: 日元兌美元匯率在經歷美日聯合干預後的強勁反彈後，近期已回吐近半漲幅，引發市場對於當局是否會發動「第二輪保衛戰」的熱烈討論。
截至周五下午，日元兌美元匯率跌至 158.40 附近，遠低於周一創下的 155.23 強勢高點。就在上周，日元兌美元一度逼近 164 的四十年低點，隨後引發日本與美國自 1998 年以來的首次聯合買入日元行動。
此次匯率回調凸顯了單純干預手段，在扭轉日元長期貶值趨勢上的局限性。美日之間顯著的利差、日本沉重的債務負擔，以及地緣政治不確定性均持續向日元施壓。隨著中東局勢導致油價上漲，市場對緊張局勢緩和的樂觀情緒減弱，支撐美元周四錄得兩周來最大單日漲幅。
市場分析指出，隨著匯率再度逼近 160 的關鍵整數關口，當局再次出手干預的可能性極高。
澳洲聯邦銀行策略師 Carol Kong 警告，若日元跌破 160 關口而當局未採取行動，將鼓勵交易員重新建立日元空頭部位，這正是政策制定者極力想避免的結果。事實上，日本在春季黃金周期間已曾三次干預匯市，顯示出其最大化心理衝擊的決心。
然而，干預的長效性仍取決於貨幣政策的配合。華僑銀行策略師 Moh Siong Sim 認為，干預若要發揮實質效果，必須配合日本央行更激進的升息，或是聯準會轉向寬鬆政策。目前，隔夜指數掉期顯示日本央行在 9 月前升息的機率約為 60%。
日本最高外匯事務官員三村淳表示，當局將協調匯率走勢與貨幣政策共同應對。
展望未來，美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 的「不惜一切代價」言論，暗示干預行動並非一次性事件。投資者目前正密切關注即將公布的美國非農就業報告與通膨數據，這些數據將成為決定日元是否會面臨新一輪拋售壓力的關鍵催化劑。
paras_en: The yen has given back nearly half of its gain since the joint intervention by Japan and the US, sparking heated discussions about whether the authorities will launch a second round of intervention.

As of Friday afternoon, the yen traded at around 158.40, far below the strong high of 155.23 set on Monday. Just last week, the yen briefly approached a 40-year low of 164, prompting Japan and the US to take their first joint action to buy yen since 1998.

The recent reversal of the yen's rate highlights the limitations of relying solely on intervention to reverse the yen's long-term depreciation trend. The significant interest rate differential between the US and Japan, Japan's heavy debt burden, and geopolitical uncertainty all continue to put pressure on the yen. With the Middle East situation driving up oil prices, market optimism about easing tensions has weakened, supporting the dollar's two-week high on Thursday.
Market analysts point out that with the yen rate again approaching the key integer threshold of 160, the possibility of the authorities intervening again is extremely high.

Australian Federal Bank strategist Carol Kong warns that if the yen breaks below the 160 threshold without intervention, it will encourage traders to rebuild yen short positions, which is exactly what policymakers are trying to avoid. In fact, Japan has intervened in the currency market three times during the spring golden period, showing its determination to maximize psychological impact.

However, the long-term effectiveness of intervention still depends on the coordination of monetary policy. OCBC Bank strategist Moh Siong Sim believes that intervention will only have a real impact if it is accompanied by the Bank of Japan's more aggressive interest rate hikes or the Fed's shift to a more accommodative policy. Currently, the overnight index swap shows that the Bank of Japan has a 60% chance of raising interest rates before September.
Japan's top foreign exchange official, Mitsuru Miyazawa, said that the authorities will coordinate the exchange rate trend with monetary policy to respond together.

Looking ahead, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's 'no matter what' comments suggest that intervention is not a one-time event. Investors are closely watching the upcoming US non-farm payroll and inflation data, which will be key catalysts for determining whether the yen will face a new round of selling pressure.

items.title: 先斬後奏！ FT：美賣歐元推高日元   歐洲央行直到交易執行才收到華府通知
items.title_en: FT: US Sells Euro to Boost Yen, ECB Only Notified After Fact
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美國上週五 (7 月 31 日) 為提振日元而賣出歐元的操作，令歐洲央行 (ECB) 措手不及，因華府在這筆歷史性匯市干預執行完畢後，才通知法蘭克福方面。
《金融時報》今 (7) 日引述多位消息人士報導，ECB 是在上週五交易成交後，才得知美國出售歐元、買入日元的動向，ECB 總裁拉加德與美國財長貝森特也在隔天就此次干預通話。
報導指出，這種「先斬後奏」凸顯出近 30 年來美日首度聯手護匯的不尋常。按戰後西方貨幣當局慣例，美國若介入匯市通常動用美元，而非動用歐元。
部分 ECB 高層認為，華府改用歐元交易，是對西方央行長期合作慣例的「空前違背」。
一名了解歐洲決策層討論的人士形容，紐約聯準銀行代表美國財政部執行的賣歐元行動「非常引人注目」且「令人遺憾」，並稱「這種事從未發生過」，二戰後西方靠互信與事前磋商維繫的匯市協調傳統，可能正受威脅。
美國財政部發言人表示，透過「匯率穩定基金」(ESF) 配置儲備資產的決定由華府自作主張，不與外國當局協調。「ESF 資產配置由財政部依市場流動性、估值等評估定奪」，上週透過 ESF 在內部重配準備資產屬職權範圍。
一名白宮官員更說：「我們尊重與國際同僚私下討論的機密性，不像 ECB。」
華府選擇賣歐元而非賣美元，主因是怕拋美元被解讀為弱勢美元信號、打臉貝森特「強勢美元政策」。
分析師也揣測，美國陪日本出手，是想避免後者在美債殖利率逼近 19 年高點時賣債換美元。
日本在 7 月最後兩天估計耗資約 13.8 兆日元 (870 億美元)，已超過 4-5 月創下的 11.73 兆日元舊紀錄。
美日上週五聯手把美元兌日元從近 164(1986 年以來低點) 拉回 157，其後略貶至 158。
市場仍憂心日本央行 (BOJ) 升息太慢，BOJ 總裁植田和男上月會議按兵不動，但坦言「通膨上行風險需更關注」，市場看好下月升息機率約 44%。
美國這次「用歐元救日元」的非常規操作，短期震懾套利空頭，卻也讓西方貨幣協調的信任底線露出一道裂痕。
paras_en: A US operation to boost the yen by selling euros last Friday (July 31) caught the European Central Bank (ECB) off guard, as Washington only notified Frankfurt after the historic intervention.

The Financial Times reported on July 7 that the ECB only learned of the US sale of euros and purchase of yen after the trade was completed on Friday, with ECB President Christine Lagarde and US Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin speaking about the intervention the following day.
The 'shoot first, tell later' approach highlights the unusual nature of the US-Japan alliance to defend their currencies, which has not happened in nearly 30 years.
Some ECB officials view the US decision to use euros in the intervention as a 'historic breach' of the long-standing cooperation between Western central banks.

A person familiar with the European decision-making process described the New York Federal Reserve's sale of euros as 'highly unusual' and 'regrettable', saying 'this has never happened before', and that the post-war tradition of Western currency coordination based on trust and prior consultation may be under threat.

A US Treasury spokesperson said that the decision to use the Exchange Stabilization Fund (ESF) to allocate reserve assets was made by Washington without coordination with foreign authorities, stating that 'ESF asset allocation is determined by the Treasury Department based on market liquidity, valuation, and other assessments'.
A White House official added that 'we respect the confidentiality of private discussions with international colleagues, unlike the ECB'.
The US chose to sell euros instead of dollars to avoid being seen as a sign of a weak dollar, which would undermine Mnuchin's 'strong dollar policy'.
Analysts speculate that the US joined Japan to avoid the latter selling bonds and buying dollars when US bond yields approached a 19-year high.
Japan is estimated to have spent around ¥13.8 trillion (approximately $870 billion) in the last two days of July, exceeding the previous record of ¥11.73 trillion set in April-May.
The US and Japan jointly pushed the dollar-yen exchange rate from near 164 (a 1986 low) back to 157 on Friday, and it later fell to 158.

Markets remain concerned that the Bank of Japan (BOJ) may be raising interest rates too slowly, with BOJ Governor Haruhiko Kuroda saying in a recent meeting that 'the risk of inflation rising is more pressing', and market expectations for a rate hike in August are around 44%.
The US's unconventional use of euros to rescue the yen has temporarily shaken out short sellers, but has also exposed a crack in the trust between Western currency coordinators.

items.title: 今年干預次數額度疑似用完！日本黃金週期間三度出手護日元 Q2砸11.74兆創單季新高
items.title_en: Intervention Quota Seems Exhausted! Japan Acts Three Times During Golden Week to Support Yen, Q2 Intervention Hits 11.74 Trillion Yen, a New Quarterly Record
paras: 日本財務省今 (7) 日公佈今年第二季每日干預明細，證實在 4 月 30 日、5 月 4 日、5 月 6 日三度買入日元，金額分別為 6.28 兆、0.78 兆、4.68 兆日元，合計 11.74 兆日元(約 785 億美元)，創日本歷次匯市防衛單季最高規模。
根據日本財務省數據，今年第二季較上月底美日聯手多出一輪單邊操作，且確認除上述三天外，黃金週期間曾有五次盤中急貶，當局未做其他平滑干預。出手干預前，日元兌美元匯率跌破 160，三輪出手後匯價拉回 155 附近。
日本財務省數據加上週五 (7 月 31 日) 與華府協同買進日元，市場推算日本在 IMF 規則下的 2026 會計年度干預額度已觸頂，與華府聯手觸發「六個月冷卻期」重置機制。理論上，日本直到 2027 年初前，不能再次單邊進場。
對日元套利交易者，干預額度疑似用罄是明確綠燈，空頭不必再防「隨時有 8 兆級砸盤」，倉位回補意願上升。
但部分投資人存疑，川普時代「基於規則的干預框架」實際約束力弱化，若日元再破 165，華府是否默許東京破例或改以口頭 + 美債端配合，仍留灰色地帶。
短期看，匯市波動率料將回落，但 2027 前「無干預承諾」本身，也可能成為下一輪空頭加槓桿的催化。
paras_en: Japan's Ministry of Finance today (the 7th) released the daily intervention details for the second quarter of this year, confirming three yen purchases on April 30, May 4, and May 6, amounting to 6.28 trillion, 0.78 trillion, and 4.68 trillion yen respectively, for a total of 11.74 trillion yen (about $78.5 billion), the largest single‑quarter foreign‑exchange market defence operation in Japan's history.

According to Ministry data, the second quarter saw one more unilateral operation compared with the end of last month’s US‑Japan joint effort, and besides the three days above, there were five intraday sharp depreciations during Golden Week that the authorities did not smooth with additional intervention. Before the interventions, the yen‑dollar rate had fallen below 160, and after the three rounds it rebounded to around 155.

Combined with the coordinated yen purchase with Washington on Friday (July 31), market participants estimate that Japan’s intervention quota for the 2026 fiscal year under IMF rules has been reached, triggering a “six‑month cooling‑off” reset mechanism with the U.S. In theory, Japan cannot make another unilateral entry until early 2027.

For yen arbitrage traders, the apparent depletion of the intervention quota is a clear green light; short sellers no longer need to guard against a sudden 8‑trillion‑yen dump, and their willingness to cover positions is increasing.

However, some investors remain skeptical, noting that the rule‑based intervention framework from the Trump era had weakened in enforceability; if the yen were to slip past 165, it is unclear whether Washington would tacitly allow Tokyo an exception or resort to verbal coordination plus U.S. Treasury actions, leaving a gray area.
In the short term, FX volatility is expected to ease, but the lack of an “intervention commitment” through 2027 could itself become a catalyst for the next wave of short‑selling leverage.

不過，原油價格周四明顯反彈。媒體報導指出，伊朗與阿曼擬定的荷姆茲海峽重啟框架，將禁止美國船舶通行，直到相關賠償完成為止。
伊朗《法斯通訊社》(Fars) 引述國會議員 Alireza Salimi 報導，荷姆茲海峽方案初步文本目前正由當局審查。根據方案，在賠償完成前，美國、以色列及其他「敵對國家」船舶將不得通行這條重要航道。
《法斯通訊社》另引述伊朗外交部消息人士指出，依照方案，船舶將由靠近伊朗海岸的北側航道進入荷姆茲海峽，並由靠近阿曼海岸的南側航道離開。在特定期限後，兩側航道都將停止通行，改由中央航道取代，屆時將由伊朗負責入境管理，出境則由伊朗與阿曼共同管理。
若上述方案屬實，其中部分內容預料難以獲得華府接受。
美國總統川普本周稍早表示，由於和平協議談判取得進展，他已取消原定對伊朗發動的強力軍事攻擊，但也警告，若雙方無法達成協議，美國已「準備好採取行動」。自 2 月底戰爭爆發以來，美伊雙方持續在威脅、攻擊與讓步之間反覆交鋒。
非農就業報告公布在即
美元周四也受到市場對貨幣政策前景的不安情緒支撐。投資人拋售美國公債，推升美債殖利率。市場焦點轉向周五公布的 7 月非農就業報告，預料將成為聯準會利率走向的重要觀察指標。
本周公布的勞動市場數據表現不一。美國 6 月職缺增幅低於預期，也較 5 月放緩，7 月 ADP 民間就業新增人數同樣不及市場預期，且增幅較 6 月降溫。
另一方面，美國首次申領失業金人數已連續第三周低於 20 萬人，這種情況自 1960 年代末以來相當罕見。
整體而言，數據顯示美國勞動市場仍具韌性，也支持聯準會近期將政策重心重新放回抑制通膨。同時，中東衝突導致油價波動，改變了通膨走勢，也讓聯準會官員對未來貨幣政策方向出現分歧。
Interactive Brokers 資深經濟學家 José Torres 表示，「我預期 7 月新增就業人數將連續第四個月放緩，估計僅增加 4 萬人。勞動市場正受到供給限制影響，勞動參與率大幅下滑、勞動力規模縮減，同時薪資壓力持續升高。」
他指出，「即使失業率維持偏低，只要整體新增就業數據疲弱，就足以帶動美國公債反彈。因為一旦固定收益市場投資人開始擔心企業可能縮減人力，市場就會開始反映經濟放緩風險。」
但他也表示，「目前中東局勢仍是市場關注焦點，因此無論非農就業報告結果如何，華爾街最在意的仍是美國與伊朗之間的互動。」
日元干預後首跌破 158
除了美元之外，匯市另一大焦點仍是日元。
美元兌日元上漲 0.4%，至 158.39，為近期日本當局大規模干預匯市以來，首次重新站上 158。
美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 這周稍早證實，美國已與日本聯手進場買進日元，這是 2011 年以來兩國首次聯合干預匯市，也是美國自 1998 年以來首次直接出手。
貝森特周二接受 CNBC 訪問時表示，美方之所以協助日本，是因為日元若持續走弱，可能衝擊整個亞洲金融市場。
在此次干預前，日元一度跌至 1 美元兌 164 日元，創 40 年新低。
RSM US 經濟學家 Joseph Brusuelas 表示，「別搞錯了，干預措施之後，日本必須推出真正的政策改變，而這代表政策利率需要上調，才能證明這筆投入的資金是值得的。」

paras_en: The dollar strengthened on Thursday (the 6th), reaching a one‑week high, supported by rising hedge demand and higher U.S. Treasury yields, while markets also awaited Friday's key employment data. Meanwhile, the yen fell below 158 per dollar, the first time since Japanese authorities intervened in the market last week.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY) tracking the greenback against six major currencies rose 0.3% to 99.94, after having slipped to a seven‑week low the previous session.
The dollar had briefly weakened earlier this week as investors shifted toward equities and other risk assets, helping Wall Street launch a strong August rally after a flat July performance.
In addition, market expectations that the Strait of Hormuz may reopen helped push oil prices lower and boosted risk appetite.

However, oil prices rebounded sharply on Thursday. Media reports said that a framework for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, drafted by Iran and Oman, would bar U.S. vessels until related compensation is settled.

Iran’s Fars news agency, citing MP Alireza Salimi, reported that a preliminary text of the Hormuz plan is currently under review by authorities. Under the proposal, U.S., Israeli and other “hostile” ships would be prohibited from using the vital waterway until compensation is paid.

Fars also quoted an Iranian foreign‑ministry source saying that, according to the plan, vessels would enter the strait via the northern channel close to Iran’s coast and exit through the southern channel near Oman. After a set period, both side channels would close and be replaced by a central channel, with Iran handling inbound traffic and Iran and Oman jointly managing outbound traffic.
If the proposal is real, parts of it are expected to be difficult for Washington to accept.

U.S. President Trump said earlier this week that, because peace‑talk progress had been made, he had cancelled the planned strong military strike on Iran, but warned that the United States is “ready to act” if a deal cannot be reached. Since the war erupted at the end of February, the U.S. and Iran have repeatedly swung between threats, attacks and concessions.
Non‑farm payroll report imminent

The dollar on Thursday was also supported by market unease over the monetary‑policy outlook. Investors sold U.S. Treasuries, pushing yields higher. Attention shifted to Friday’s July non‑farm payroll report, expected to be a key gauge of the Fed’s rate trajectory.

Labor‑market data released this week were mixed. U.S. June job openings rose less than expected and slowed from May, and July ADP private‑sector employment added fewer jobs than forecast, with growth cooling versus June.
Conversely, first‑time unemployment claims in the United States fell below 200,000 for the third consecutive week, a rarity not seen since the late 1960s.

Overall, the data show that the U.S. labor market remains resilient, supporting the Fed’s recent shift back to focusing on inflation control. At the same time, Middle‑East conflict‑driven oil‑price swings have altered inflation trends and created policy‑direction splits among Fed officials.

Interactive Brokers senior economist José Torres said, “I expect July’s job additions to slow for the fourth straight month, estimating only 40,000 new jobs. The labor market is being constrained by supply‑side factors, with a sharp drop in labor‑force participation, a shrinking workforce and rising wage pressure.”

He added, “Even with a still‑low unemployment rate, weak overall job growth is enough to trigger a rebound in U.S. Treasuries, because once fixed‑income investors start fearing companies may cut staff, the market will price in slowdown risk.”
He also noted, “The Middle‑East situation remains the market’s focus, so regardless of the payroll outcome, Wall Street’s biggest concern is the interaction between the United States and Iran.”
Yen falls below 158 after intervention
Beyond the dollar, the yen remains a major market focus.
The dollar‑yen pair rose 0.4% to 158.39, the first time since Japanese authorities launched a large‑scale intervention that the rate has climbed back above 158.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confirmed earlier this week that the United States has teamed up with Japan to buy yen, marking the first joint intervention since 2011 and the first direct U.S. action since 1998.
Bessent told CNBC on Tuesday that the U.S. is helping Japan because a continuously weakening yen could damage the broader Asian financial system.
Before the intervention, the yen had slipped to ¥164 per dollar, a 40‑year low.
RSM US economist Joseph Brusuelas said, “Don’t get it wrong—after the intervention Japan must enact real policy changes, meaning the policy rate needs to be raised to justify the money spent.”
